notesId:
Baru sejak v1.5.194:
- Pustaka sekarang mencari lagu di semua penyimpanan (durasi 60 detik ke atas), bukan cuma folder Music.
- Baris vokal latar sekarang tampil di lirik tersinkron.
- Blur sampul animasi sekarang native penuh + akselerasi NEON.
- Renderer kembali ke Skia.

Perbaikan audit (v1.5.200 - v1.5.203):
- Grid kategori genre di Browse dihapus.
- Fitur tulis tag ReplayGain dihapus (pemutaran tidak berubah).
- Antrean, shuffle, dan notifikasi lebih andal.

v1.5.207:
- Navbar tidak lagi hitam saat cold start.
notesEn:
What's new since v1.5.194:
- Library now finds songs across all shared storage (60 seconds or longer), not just the Music folder.
- Background vocal lines now render in synced lyrics.
- Animated cover blur is fully native and NEON-accelerated.
- Renderer is back to Skia.

Audit fixes (v1.5.200 - v1.5.203):
- Genre category grid removed from Browse.
- ReplayGain tag writing removed (playback unchanged).
- More reliable queue, shuffle, and notifications.

v1.5.207:
- Fixed the navigation bar staying black on cold start.
